evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Speaker controls the framing of facts, drawing a categorical distinction that positions owned intelligence as superior — informational power via definitional control.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Logical argument structuring a commodity/asset hierarchy — rational persuasion through categorical reasoning, with informational control over the framing.
Speaker positions themselves as controller of the thesis, restating and thus owning the informational frame — informational power through meta-framing of prior claims.
